title: ARM BREAKER
line: Grab the wrist, drive the elbow the wrong way. A broken arm can't swing: he is out of the fight, or dead if he was already hurt.
input: GRAB (LIGHT + HEAVY close) on a BROKEN thug

title: KNEE SNAP
line: A stamping front kick to the kneecap. The leg folds backwards and he drops onto the other knee.
input: GRAB + FORWARD on a BROKEN thug

title: NECK CRACK
line: Slip behind him, both hands on the jaw, one hard twist. He goes limp before he hits the street.
input: GRAB + BACK on a BROKEN thug

title: DEATH TOUCH
line: Five fingertip strikes to five points on the chest. He walks three more steps, then his heart stops.

title: EYE GOUGE
line: Thumbs in both eyes. He reels blind and screaming, swinging at nothing, then drops.
input: GRAB + FORWARD on a BROKEN thug

title: PIPE JAVELIN
line: WEAPON BRANCH. Holding a pipe: hurl it through him and pin him to the wall behind.
input: With a PIPE: GRAB + BACK on a BROKEN thug

title: HEART PUNCH
line: One straight punch through the breastbone. The fist comes out of his back holding his heart.

title: SPINE RIP
line: An uppercut that doesn't stop: the head comes off upwards with the spine still hanging from it.
input: GRAB + FORWARD on a BROKEN thug

title: BACK BREAKER
line: Lift him over your head and bring his back down across your knee. He folds the wrong way.
input: GRAB + BACK on a BROKEN thug

title: THROAT PUNCH
line: Two knuckles into the windpipe. He folds over, clutching his throat, and the air never comes back.
input: GRAB + FORWARD on a BROKEN thug

title: TEMPLE TAP
line: PRESSURE POINT. Two fingers to the temple, once. His eyes roll back and he tips over like a felled tree.

title: HOME RUN
line: WEAPON BRANCH. Holding anything blunt: a full swing to the head. He spins through the air and lands two cars down.
input: With a BAT, PIPE, CROWBAR, BOARD or HAMMER: GRAB + FORWARD on a BROKEN thug

title: RIB BREAKER
line: Five body hooks, left right left right left. Every one cracks a rib; the last one folds him in half.

title: JAW BREAKER
line: An uppercut that pops the jaw out, then a spinning backfist that sends it the other way. Teeth everywhere.
input: GRAB + BACK on a BROKEN thug

title: CHAIN NOOSE
line: WEAPON BRANCH. Holding a chain: whip it round his neck, yank him in, knee to the back. The chain does the rest.
input: With a CHAIN: GRAB + BACK on a BROKEN thug

title: THE TWO-WAY
line: SUPER. Kick the leg so it bends backwards; he drops to one knee. A side kick snaps his head round, you hold his hand so he stays up, then the heel comes back the other way and takes the head clean off.
input: FURY full: LB + RB on a BROKEN thug

title: SKULL CRUSHER
line: SUPER. Both palms clap together on his temples. Once. That is all it takes.
input: FURY full: LB + RB on a BROKEN thug

title: FLAMINGO REAPER
line: SUPER. Three kicks off the same leg without it touching down (head, ribs, head), then a spinning left kick finisher that sends the head into the next street.
input: FURY full: LB + RB on a BROKEN thug
